library(ggplot2)
Sys.setlocale("LC_CTYPE", "en_US.UTF-8") 
## [1] "en_US.UTF-8"
data_railway <- read.csv("2020-11-15成渝高铁上行成都局1车在前3号弓_All.csv")
ggplot(data_railway, aes(x = 整公里数)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = ..density..), binwidth = 2, color = "black", fill = "lightblue") +
  geom_density(color = "red", size = 1) +
  labs(title = "整公里数直方图", x = "整公里数", y = "Density")
